{{Youmay|the general term|the [[Witches of Dathomir]] or [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]], who served a similar function}}
{{Quote|I should have sensed such betrayal from a Nightsister witch.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="JediAlliance">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Nightsisters-SWE.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Nightsisters, witches of Dathomir who used the dark side of the Force, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
A '''witch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|user]] of [[Magic/Legends|magic]] who tended to use the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]]. Witches were found in primitive cultures where the concept of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was known as magic. The [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]] were an order of witches as were the [[Mind-witch]]es.

[[Sith sorcerer|Sith sorceresses]] were also alternatively referred to as witches.

[[Morag]] was a witch from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Female [[Sayormi]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] were also called witches.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

The term "witch" was also used as an insult towards [[Gender/Legends|female]] beings. For example, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] referred to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] as a witch.
